+# --- KF-048: the codex access-token freshness pre-flight (Sprint 261) ------------------------
+# codex_auth <exp offset s> — a crafted auth.json whose access token is h.<base64url({"exp": now+offset})>.s;
+# prints the exp instant (ISO 8601 UTC)
+codex_auth() {
+  python3 -I - "$T/creds/.codex/auth.json" "$1" <<'PY'
+import base64, json, sys, time
+exp = int(time.time()) + int(sys.argv[2])
+pl = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({"exp": exp}).encode()).decode().rstrip("=")
+json.dump({"auth_mode": "chatgpt", "tokens": {"access_token": "h.%s.s" % pl, "refresh_token": "R", "account_id": "a"}},
+          open(sys.argv[1], "w"))
+print(time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime(exp)))
+PY
+}

+codex_auth() {
+  python3 -I - "$T/creds/.codex/auth.json" "$1" <<'PY'

+PY

  fi

# run_usd stays the single-cap fallback (suite v1 batches, a kind without an entry) and
# --run-cap overrides both kinds. reserve_usd is kept for spend.sh; DEC-0559 released the
# reserve (a batch's --max-usd = 1,500 - spend so far - concurrency x the largest cap).
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250, run_usd_by_type: {build: 15, review-catch: 20}}
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}

  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

done
arm_index() { local i; for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do [[ "${ARMS[$i]}" == "$1" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done; echo -1; }
for a in ${PL_ARM[@]+"${PL_ARM[@]}"}; do i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_PLANNED[$i]=$(( ${C_PLANNED[$i]} + 1 )); done

is_rerun() { [[ "$RERUN_LIST" == *$'\n'"$1"$'\n'* ]]; }   # flagged on resume, no replacement row yet
is_paused() { jq -e --arg a "$1" 'has($a)' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON" >/dev/null; }

# account_row <arm> <kind> <run_id> <status> <cost> <degraded> — counters and spend for one row
account_row() {
  local arm="$1" kind="$2" rid="$3" st="$4" cost="$5" deg="$6" i
  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
  case "$st" in
    completed) C_COMPLETED[$i]=$(( ${C_COMPLETED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
    cap_failure) C_CAP[$i]=$(( ${C_CAP[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
    agent_error) C_FAILED[$i]=$(( ${C_FAILED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
    *) C_EXCLUDED[$i]=$(( ${C_EXCLUDED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
  esac
  [[ "$deg" == true ]] && C_DEGRADED[$i]=$(( ${C_DEGRADED[$i]} + 1 ))
  ROWS_USD="$(fadd "$ROWS_USD" "$cost")"
  local cap; cap="$(cap_for "$kind")"   # the trial kind's cap (DEC-0567)
  if [[ "$st" == cap_failure ]]; then
    if awk -v c="$cost" -v r="$cap" 'BEGIN { exit !(c < r) }'; then
      SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cap")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
      log "assumed cap: $rid ended cap_failure at USD $cost; USD $cap ($kind cap) charged to spent"
    else
      SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    fi
  else
    spend_charge "$st" "$cost" "$rid" "$cap"
    if [[ "$st" == completed ]]; then est_record "$arm|$kind" "$kind" "$CHARGED_COST"; fi
  fi
}

resume_cursor() { local k; for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do is_done "${PL_RUN[$k]}" || { echo "$k"; return; }; done; echo "$PLAN_N"; }

  local per='{}' i finished=null
  for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
    rerow_ids=$'\n'; for r in ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"}; do rerow_ids="$rerow_ids$r"$'\n'; done
    want_st=" ${RERUN_STATUSES[*]+"${RERUN_STATUSES[*]}"} "
    while IFS=$'\t' read -r rid st cost deg; do
      k=-1
      for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
      [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || continue
      if [[ "$want_ids" == *$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'* ]] \
         || { [[ "$want_st" == *" $st "* ]] && [[ "$rerow_ids" != *$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'* ]]; }; then
        # DEC-0553: out of the done set, so the plan launches it again; no counter, no assumed charge;
        # its reported cost (real spend) stays in spent
        [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
        RERUN_LIST="$RERUN_LIST$rid"$'\n'; SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
        RERUN_OLD="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg s "$st" --arg c "$cost" '.[$r] = {status: $s, cost: ($c | tonumber)}' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")"
        continue
      fi
      DONE_LIST="$DONE_LIST$rid"$'\n'
      i="$(arm_index "${PL_ARM[$k]}")"; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=$(( ${C_LAUNCHED[$i]} + 1 )); LAUNCHED=$((LAUNCHED + 1))
      account_row "${PL_ARM[$k]}" "${PL_KIND[$k]}" "$rid" "$st" "$cost" "$deg"
    done < <(jq -R -r --arg b "$BATCH" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b)
               | [.run_id, .status, ((.cost_usd // 0) | tostring), ((.degraded // false) | tostring)] | @tsv' "$ROWS")
  fi
  n_rerun="$(printf '%s' "$RERUN_LIST" | grep -c . || true)"
  [[ ${#RERUN_STATUSES[@]} -eq 0 && ${#RERUN_IDS[@]} -eq 0 ]] \

head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1081 — remove_colliding reserves the basename of every hidden-overlay .py dest without excluding `__init__.py` (the fixture walk at 1087 excludes it, the overlay set does not, and the later discard only drops conftest.py). If a hidden overlay ships a package marker such as `tests/hidden/__init__.py`, every `__init__.py` the agent adds outside the fixture (for example a new `src/pkg/__init__.py`) is deleted before grading. The new package then stops importing, and a correct solution grades as failing, which is the outcome 1.2.11 was meant to prevent.
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1087 — the reserved set takes every .py file under a fixture tests/ or test/ directory, helper modules included (helpers.py, utils.py, _oracle_x.py), not just collected test modules. Lines 1090-1102 then delete any agent-added file with that basename anywhere in the tree, including non-test source modules inside real packages (e.g. `src/app/helpers.py`) where pytest has no basename collision. A correct solution can lose its own module and fail hidden tests. This is also wider than the header comment at 222, which says "a fixture test file's basename". The rule should be limited to collected test-module names (test_*.py / *_test.py) in package-less directories.
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1090 — the tree walk does not skip vendored or virtualenv directories (.venv/, venv/, site-packages, node_modules). When an agent creates a virtualenv inside the sandbox, every installed module whose basename matches a reserved name is unlinked from the graded tree. This breaks imports in an unrelated way and inflates colliding_tests_removed.
head/evals/tests/run-ablation.bats:95 — the comment contradicts the assertion under it. It says suite v2 build tasks only carry bounds timeout_min {IMPLEMENT: 35} and that "A0 BARE stays 70 min" because phase_defaults declares BARE: 70 (so the PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX derivation does not apply). Line 97, and RAB-27 at :112, then assert watchdog 9600 / phase_sum_min 80, which is exactly that derivation. Both the planner tmin (run-ablation.sh:757) and pipeline-run.sh phase_cap resolve BARE as task bounds, then phase_defaults (70). So either the v2 tasks also declare a BARE bound, and the comment is wrong, or the assertion is wrong. The A0 time budget is a fairness parameter of the ablation, so this needs to be stated correctly.
head/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh:806 — the KF-048 horizon sums watchdog_s over the whole plan, a0_bare trials included, even though only codex_arms need the token. On --resume it also sums the whole recorded plan rather than the trials still to run. A resume that is nearly finished, or a plan mostly made of a0_bare trials, can be refused for a token that would outlive every remaining codex-using trial. The sum should cover only the not-yet-done trials of codex-using arms.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED

content.text:
My verdict is **CHANGES_REQUIRED**, and the review is in `review.md` with five findings. I only read the code; I didn't run any of the bats tests.

The blocker is in the grader change. The new step that deletes agent-added Python files sharing a name with a test file (to stop pytest aborting collection) deletes far more than it should. That can make a correct solution grade as failing, which is the very problem the step was added to fix:

1. **`ablation-grade.sh:1081`** — names taken from the hidden test files aren't filtered for `__init__.py`. If the hidden tests include an `__init__.py`, every `__init__.py` the agent adds outside the fixture is deleted, and any new package it created stops importing.
2. **`ablation-grade.sh:1087`** — every `.py` under a fixture `tests/` or `test/` directory counts, including helpers like `helpers.py` or `utils.py`. An agent's own source module with the same name anywhere in the tree is deleted, even inside a real package where pytest has no conflict. The header comment says this only applies to test files; the code goes further.
3. **`ablation-grade.sh:1090`** — the scan doesn't skip virtualenvs or vendored directories, so a sandbox venv loses any installed modules that match those names.

Two lesser findings:

4. **`run-ablation.bats:95`** — the comment says the bare-agent arm (A0) keeps its 70-minute budget. The assertions at line 97 and in the new `--types` test (RAB-27) expect 80 minutes. Both the planner and `pipeline-run.sh` read 70 from the suite defaults unless a task sets its own BARE limit. I couldn't check this because the task files aren't in the PR. So either the v2 tasks set an 80-minute limit and the comment is wrong, or the assertion is wrong. It matters because that budget is a fairness setting across the ablation arms.
5. **`run-ablation.sh:806`** — the new check that the codex token won't expire mid-batch adds up the time for the whole plan. That includes trials from the bare arm, which never uses codex, and on `--resume` it includes trials already finished. A nearly finished resume can be refused for a token that would outlast every trial still to run.

The rest looks correct to me:
- the `--types` fix;
- per-kind caps: dispatch, assumed charges, the largest-cap in-flight reserve, and `--resume` reading caps from the manifest (old manifests fall back to `run_usd`);
- the codex `auth.json` copy with a placeholder refresh token;
- the manifest fields, which `--resume` correctly leaves untouched.
